mission.name: Cerea Taxi Shift
mission.objective: Work a taxi shift from 07:00 to 17:00. Collect passengers and earn fares.
mission.hint: Prototype journey: collect the test traveller at Sosta Municipio, then follow signs north via Via Oberdan and the fictional Test Link to Test Hamlet. Added countryside is fictional.

notes: Modern road geometry at local metre scale; no claim of historical reconstruction.
Designated stopping bays are gameplay placements, not verified real parking permissions.
Building footprints are sourced; heights, materials and landmark silhouettes are simplified.
One-way tags are used for directions; road-rule enforcement and traffic are not simulated.
provenance.roadClearance: Full road width plus 1.6m verge; includes junction caps and game parking bays. Trimmed polygons are used for scenery, collisions and atlas.

provenance.source: OpenStreetMap Cerea subset plus original fictional prototype extension
provenance.licence: OSM-derived database content: ODbL-1.0; no separate licence assigned to original game content
provenance.synthetic: All Test Link/Test Hamlet geometry, buildings and stops north of the source subset are fictional. No claim about real countryside roads.
